nodes.statement: Positive proportionality is equivalent to constant d_f=log W_Of-log W_Sf; inf max-cell log distance is (max d-min d)/4. This is an application of classical positive rank-one and Chebyshev reasoning.

rules.binding: Each of the four constructions has its own explicit witness: one stable nonlinear table, one ordinal-conflict table, a family of condition-dependent maps, and a two-person cancellation pair. Participant binding is retained within each matrix; the constructions are not one jointly instantiated biological model.
rules.joint_witness: Four explicit numerical or functional constructions; alternative classes are not conjoined as actual biological truths.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: Separate countermodels demonstrate four distinct inference failures. Stable-map membership is not imposed on the condition-dependent-map witness. Each countermodel has its own specified domain.
rules.instance_quantification: Binding holds inside each witness. The fourth witness explicitly quantifies two people to establish population cancellation; it does not combine their measurements into one actual-person premise.
